newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity fund flows up in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity fund flows up in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: Cash inflows to U.S. equity funds rose to $1.21 billion for the three-day period ending June 26, up slightly from inflows of $1.18 billion for the two days ended June 23, a Mutual Fund Trim Tabs survey showed Monday.
Inflows to growth and income funds jumped to $1.65 billion from $628 million, the tracking firm said. Growth funds posted outflows of $226 million versus inflows of $511 million.
Outflows to aggressive growth funds rose to $186 million from $31 million.
International funds inflows dropped to $150 million from $1.24 million.
Bond funds inflows rose to $369 million from $86 million. Muni funds outflows increased to $298 million from $103 million.
Flexible/balanced/mixed funds inflows rose to $970 million from $99 million.
High-yield funds inflows slowed to $21 million from $64 million.
